Final routes runtime/service progress separately from root-page rebuilding,
and uses content-height chooser rows with a capped scrollable preset list.
Renderer, batch and Gallery implementations remain unchanged by those fixes.

SCOPE
Select 1–100 remote/local/live-project photos and a committed local preset.
Remote originals are acquired through AlbumController; local files are reused.
Independent app-owned processing survives Activity rebinds. One full-size
mutable sRGB bitmap is processed in bounded strips; JPEG 95 output is separate,
with capture/orientation EXIF whitelisted and unfiltered thumbnail omitted.
No source overwrite or silent resize. Effects are the existing phone-side
NCP curve approximation, not native Nikon Picture Control rendering.
Content/preset/model identity deduplicates derived copies; publication failure
keeps the local copy. Effects do not become live-project original members.
Originals/effects save directly to MediaStore on 29+. API 26–28 public-Pictures
permission/scanner behavior is covered only by host facades, not old-OS QA.
Final code adds async live gallery publication so copy/lock work is off the
camera worker, and clears stale manual-save summaries.

CONFIRMED HOST CHECKS
All focused runners exit 0: 683 controller + 342 store + 100 folder = 1,125
album checks, plus 99 Gallery and 40 batch, total 1,264. Host doubles do not establish Android
codec/EXIF/MediaStore/foreground-service or physical-camera behavior.
